voiceSummary: Whirlpool of India Limited filed a press release regarding unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated EBITDA stood at Rs 40 Cr with a margin of 2.1%, which was lower by 140 basis points compared to the previous year.
